findings.text: errorPrevLine decrements pos.Line unconditionally; if called when lexer is on line 1 (e.g., input starts with newline in lexString), it reports line 0 which is invalid since lines start at 1.
errorControlChar passes lx.pos-1 to errorPos; if a control character is at position 0 (start of input), Start becomes -1, an invalid byte offset.
errorf's atEOF branch also decrements Line and sets Start=lx.pos-1; if EOF is reached at position 0 (empty input), it reports line 0 and start -1.
getPos clamps Len to 1 when <=0, but if lx.pos < lx.start due to backup edge cases, the Start position may not reflect the actual error location accurately.
